ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_rank_regret_product_aggregate
ir.intuition: Instead of margin-based pairwise losses, this loss uses the product of the rank gap and regret gap signals as a modulation factor on the sigmoid probability difference, emphasizing pairs with large combined rank and regret disparities. The loss aggregates by computing a normalized weighted sum emphasizing pairs with higher regret and rank differences, thereby shifting the paradigm from margin subtraction to direct product-based modulation and novel signal usage.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_factor = relu(delta_rank) + 1e-6
regret_factor = relu(delta_regret) + 1e-6
modulation = log(sigmoid(alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))) * rank_factor * regret_factor
loss_per_pair = -modulation * weight
loss = sum(loss_per_pair) / (sum(weight * rank_factor * regret_factor) + epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch['weight']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))

    rank_factor = ops.relu(delta_rank) + 1e-6
    regret_factor = ops.relu(delta_regret) + 1e-6

    log_sig = ops.logsigmoid(alpha * (lpw - lpl))

    modulation = log_sig * rank_factor * regret_factor

    weighted_loss_per_pair = -modulation * weight

    norm_factor = ops.sum(weight * rank_factor * regret_factor) + 1e-12

    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss_per_pair) / norm_factor
    return loss
